title: Relationship Manager
description:
Roles and Responsibilities

- Manage and follow up with leads from property owners, tenants, buyers, and sellers.
- Understand customer requirements, budgets, and property preferences, and recommend suitable solutions.
- Explain company services, property details, pricing, and procedures clearly.
- Coordinate property visits, confirm schedules, and collect customer feedback.
- Build strong customer relationships through timely communication and professional service.
- Follow up with prospects, handle objections, support negotiations, and drive successful closures.
- Coordinate with internal teams for property availability, documentation, agreements, and transaction completion.
- Maintain accurate lead details, call updates, visit outcomes, and follow-up schedules in the CRM or lead tracker.
- Monitor active leads and ensure timely follow-ups without missing assigned opportunities.
- Prepare daily work plans and end-of-day reports, and attend scheduled team meetings.
- Resolve customer queries and escalate complaints or issues to the reporting manager when required.
- Achieve assigned sales and closure targets while maintaining transparency, confidentiality, and compliance with company policies.

title: Business Development Manager
description: Coordinate tenants, rent administration, inspections and maintenance for managed properties.

title: Business Development Executive
description: Support project coordination, contractor communication and progress tracking on development sites.
